Claims 1-19, are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103(a) as being unpatentable over Lombardi
et al., WO2009/013126 A1, and Bendiera et al., WO2008/074749 A1, in view of Hout et al.,
W02013/119950 A2, Greco et al., Molecular and Cellular Endocrinology (2010), Vol. 321(1), pp.
44-49, and Lipska et al., BMC Cancer (2009), 9:436, pp. 1-9.
